name: solanabadge-connectpay
description: Stands between a Solana Breakpoint badge and Quidli Connect.

CONNECT_API_KEY.description: Your Connect API key: [connect.quid.li](https://connect.quid.li) > **Enable API access**. Use an account funded with small amounts only.

BADGE_IDS.description: Your badge's id, from **Set up** in the Connect Pay app on the badge, e.g. `7K2Q9M`. Several: separate with commas.
